gadgets.sink: arbitrary bytes into a cookie value via RFC2109 quoted-string octal escapes
gadgets.payload: Cookie: session="AA\015\012BB"   ->  the application receives AA<CR><LF>BB
gadgets.effect: injects bytes that cannot appear literally in an HTTP header (CR, LF, NUL, space) into whatever the application builds from the cookie -- a cache key, a store key, a log line, a downstream protocol
gadgets.precondition: the cookie value is used to build something line- or delimiter-sensitive
gadgets.trap: only the OCTAL form inside a quoted value is decoded. Verified on 2.2.2: "AA\101BB" arrives as AAABB, while "AA\x41BB" arrives as AAx41BB and a percent-encoded %0d%0a is NOT decoded at all. A raw control byte in the header never survives, so testing only the raw and percent forms produces a false negative.
